"""Durable SQLite-backed incident store."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
import time
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from .models import (
    SLA_SECONDS,
    VALID_TRANSITIONS,
    AuditEvent,
    Incident,
    IncidentNotFound,
    IncidentStatus,
    InvalidTransition,
    Severity,
    VersionConflict,
)

DEFAULT_DEDUPE_WINDOW = 300.0
DEFAULT_LEASE_SECONDS = 30.0

_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incidents (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    owner TEXT,
    alert_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    escalation_level INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
    sla_deadline REAL NOT NULL,
    claim_worker TEXT,
    claim_expires_at REAL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_incidents_fingerprint
    ON incidents(fingerprint);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_incidents_status
    ON incidents(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_incidents_sla
    ON incidents(sla_deadline);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    incident_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    details TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (incident_id) REFERENCES incidents(id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_incident
    ON audit_events(incident_id, id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    incident_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    created TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL
);
"""


def _now(clock: Callable[[], float] | None) -> float:
    return clock() if clock is not None else time.time()


class SQLiteIncidentStore:
    def __init__(
        self,
        database: str,
        clock: Callable[[], float] | None = None,
        dedupe_window: float = DEFAULT_DEDUPE_WINDOW,
        lease_seconds: float = DEFAULT_LEASE_SECONDS,
    ) -> None:
        self.database = database
        self._clock = clock
        self.dedupe_window = dedupe_window
        self.lease_seconds = lease_seconds
        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(database, isolation_level=None, timeout=30.0)
        self._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self._conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        self._conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")
        self._conn.executescript(_SCHEMA)

    # -- helpers -----------------------------------------------------------

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._conn.close()

    def __enter__(self) -> "SQLiteIncidentStore":
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc: object) -> None:
        self.close()

    def _row_to_incident(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> Incident:
        return Incident(
            id=row["id"],
            fingerprint=row["fingerprint"],
            title=row["title"],
            severity=Severity(row["severity"]),
            status=IncidentStatus(row["status"]),
            owner=row["owner"],
            alert_count=row["alert_count"],
            version=row["version"],
            escalation_level=row["escalation_level"],
            created_at=row["created_at"],
            updated_at=row["updated_at"],
            sla_deadline=row["sla_deadline"],
        )

    def _row_to_event(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> AuditEvent:
        return AuditEvent(
            id=row["id"],
            incident_id=row["incident_id"],
            type=row["type"],
            timestamp=row["timestamp"],
            details=json.loads(row["details"]),
        )

    def _add_event(
        cur: sqlite3.Cursor,
        incident_id: str,
        event_type: str,
        timestamp: float,
        details: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> None:
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO audit_events (incident_id, type, timestamp, details) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (incident_id, event_type, timestamp, json.dumps(details)),
        )

    # -- ingest ------------------------------------------------------------

    def ingest_alert(
        self,
        fingerprint: str,
        title: str,
        severity: Severity | str,
        source: str = "unknown",
        details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        idempotency_key: str | None = None,
        now: float | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Incident, bool]:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        sev = Severity(severity)
        detail_payload = details or {}
        fp = fingerprint
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                row = cur.execute(
                    "SELECT incident_id, created, result_json FROM idempotency "
                    "WHERE key = ?",
                    (idempotency_key,),
                ).fetchone()
                if row is not None:
                    created_flag = row["created"]
                    self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                    return (
                        self.get(row["incident_id"]),  # type: ignore[return-value]
                        created_flag == "created",
                    )
            existing = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE fingerprint = ? AND status != 'resolved' "
                "ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1",
                (fp,),
            ).fetchone()
            if existing is not None:
                incident = self._row_to_incident(existing)
                if ts - incident.updated_at <= self.dedupe_window:
                    new_version = incident.version + 1
                    cur.execute(
                        "UPDATE incidents SET alert_count = alert_count + 1, "
                        "version = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                        (new_version, ts, incident.id),
                    )
                    self._add_event(
                        cur,
                        incident.id,
                        "duplicate_alert",
                        ts,
                        {"source": source, "details": detail_payload},
                    )
                    result = self._row_to_incident(
                        cur.execute(
                            "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident.id,)
                        ).fetchone()
                    )
                    if idempotency_key is not None:
                        cur.execute(
                            "INSERT INTO idempotency (key, incident_id, created, result_json) "
                            "VALUES (?, ?, 'duplicate_alert', ?)",
                            (idempotency_key, result.id, json.dumps(None)),
                        )
                    self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                    return result, False
            incident_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            sla = ts + SLA_SECONDS[sev]
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO incidents "
                "(id, fingerprint, title, severity, status, owner, alert_count, "
                "version, escalation_level, created_at, updated_at, sla_deadline, "
                "claim_worker, claim_expires_at) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'open', NULL, 1, 1, 0, ?, ?, ?, NULL, NULL)",
                (
                    incident_id,
                    fp,
                    title,
                    sev.value,
                    ts,
                    ts,
                    sla,
                ),
            )
            self._add_event(
                cur,
                incident_id,
                "created",
                ts,
                {
                    "fingerprint": fp,
                    "title": title,
                    "severity": sev.value,
                    "source": source,
                    "details": detail_payload,
                },
            )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                cur.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO idempotency (key, incident_id, created, result_json) "
                    "VALUES (?, ?, 'created', ?)",
                    (idempotency_key, incident_id, json.dumps(None)),
                )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result, True
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    # -- reads -------------------------------------------------------------

    def get(self, incident_id: str) -> Incident | None:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        return self._row_to_incident(row) if row else None

    def list(
        self,
        status: str | None = None,
        severity: str | None = None,
        owner: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[Incident]:
        clauses: list[str] = []
        params: list[Any] = []
        if status is not None:
            clauses.append("status = ?")
            params.append(IncidentStatus(status).value)
        if severity is not None:
            clauses.append("severity = ?")
            params.append(Severity(severity).value)
        if owner is not None:
            clauses.append("owner = ?")
            params.append(owner)
        where = f"WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            f"SELECT * FROM incidents {where} ORDER BY created_at", params
        ).fetchall()
        return [self._row_to_incident(r) for r in rows]

    def events(self, incident_id: str) -> list[AuditEvent]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE incident_id = ? ORDER BY id",
            (incident_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [self._row_to_event(r) for r in rows]

    # -- updates -----------------------------------------------------------

    def update(
        self,
        incident_id: str,
        expected_version: int,
        owner: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        idempotency_key: str | None = None,
        now: float | None = None,
    ) -> Incident:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                row = cur.execute(
                    "SELECT incident_id, created FROM idempotency WHERE key = ?",
                    (idempotency_key,),
                ).fetchone()
                if row is not None:
                    self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                    return self.get(row["incident_id"])  # type: ignore[return-value]
            row = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise IncidentNotFound(incident_id)
            incident = self._row_to_incident(row)
            if incident.version != expected_version:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise VersionConflict(incident_id, expected_version, incident.version)
            new_owner = incident.owner
            new_status = incident.status
            owner_changed = False
            status_changed = False
            if owner is not None:
                stripped = owner.strip() or None
                if stripped != new_owner:
                    new_owner = stripped
                    owner_changed = True
            if status is not None:
                target = IncidentStatus(status)
                if target != new_status:
                    if (new_status, target) not in VALID_TRANSITIONS:
                        self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                        raise InvalidTransition(new_status.value, target.value)
                    new_status = target
                    status_changed = True
            if not owner_changed and not status_changed:
                self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                return incident
            new_version = incident.version + 1
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE incidents SET owner = ?, status = ?, version = ?, "
                "updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (
                    new_owner,
                    new_status.value,
                    new_version,
                    ts,
                    incident_id,
                ),
            )
            if owner_changed:
                self._add_event(
                    cur,
                    incident_id,
                    "owner_changed",
                    ts,
                    {"owner": new_owner},
                )
            if status_changed:
                self._add_event(
                    cur,
                    incident_id,
                    "status_changed",
                    ts,
                    {"from": incident.status.value, "to": new_status.value},
                )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                cur.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO idempotency (key, incident_id, created, result_json) "
                    "VALUES (?, ?, 'update', ?)",
                    (idempotency_key, incident_id, json.dumps(None)),
                )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result
        except Exception:
            try:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                pass
            raise

    # -- escalation --------------------------------------------------------

    def claim_due_escalation(
        self, worker_id: str, now: float | None = None
    ) -> Incident | None:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            row = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents "
                "WHERE status != 'resolved' AND claim_worker IS NULL "
                "AND sla_deadline <= ? "
                "ORDER BY sla_deadline ASC LIMIT 1",
                (ts,),
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                return None
            incident = self._row_to_incident(row)
            expires = ts + self.lease_seconds
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE incidents SET claim_worker = ?, claim_expires_at = ? "
                "WHERE id = ?",
                (worker_id, expires, incident.id),
            )
            self._add_event(
                cur,
                incident.id,
                "escalation_claimed",
                ts,
                {"worker_id": worker_id, "expires_at": expires},
            )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident.id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    def complete_escalation(
        self, incident_id: str, worker_id: str, now: float | None = None
    ) -> Incident:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            row = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise IncidentNotFound(incident_id)
            incident = self._row_to_incident(row)
            if row["claim_worker"] != worker_id:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise VersionConflict(incident_id, 0, incident.version)
            new_level = incident.escalation_level + 1
            new_version = incident.version + 1
            new_deadline = ts + SLA_SECONDS[incident.severity]
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE incidents SET escalation_level = ?, version = ?, "
                "sla_deadline = ?, claim_worker = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, "
                "updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (new_level, new_version, new_deadline, ts, incident_id),
            )
            self._add_event(
                cur,
                incident_id,
                "escalated",
                ts,
                {
                    "worker_id": worker_id,
                    "level": new_level,
                    "next_deadline": new_deadline,
                },
            )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    def recover_expired_claims(self, now: float | None = None) -> int:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            rows = cur.execute(
                "SELECT id, claim_worker FROM incidents "
                "WHERE claim_worker IS NOT NULL AND claim_expires_at <= ?",
                (ts,),
            ).fetchall()
            count = 0
            for row in rows:
                cur.execute(
                    "UPDATE incidents SET claim_worker = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL "
                    "WHERE id = ?",
                    (row["id"],),
                )
                self._add_event(
                    cur,
                    row["id"],
                    "claim_recovered",
                    ts,
                    {"worker_id": row["claim_worker"]},
                )
                count += 1
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return count
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    # -- export / import ---------------------------------------------------

    def export_records(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        incidents = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM incidents ORDER BY created_at"
        ).fetchall()
        events = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM audit_events ORDER BY id"
        ).fetchall()
        result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for row in incidents:
            inc = self._row_to_incident(row)
            result.append(
                {
                    "kind": "incident",
                    "id": inc.id,
                    "fingerprint": inc.fingerprint,
                    "title": inc.title,
                    "severity": inc.severity.value,
                    "status": inc.status.value,
                    "owner": inc.owner,
                    "alert_count": inc.alert_count,
                    "version": inc.version,
                    "escalation_level": inc.escalation_level,
                    "created_at": inc.created_at,
                    "updated_at": inc.updated_at,
                    "sla_deadline": inc.sla_deadline,
                    "claim_worker": row["claim_worker"],
                    "claim_expires_at": row["claim_expires_at"],
                }
            )
        for row in events:
            ev = self._row_to_event(row)
            result.append(
                {
                    "kind": "event",
                    "id": ev.id,
                    "incident_id": ev.incident_id,
                    "type": ev.type,
                    "timestamp": ev.timestamp,
                    "details": ev.details,
                }
            )
        return result

    def import_records(self, records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            imported = 0
            for record in records:
                if record["kind"] == "incident":
                    existing = cur.execute(
                        "SELECT 1 FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (record["id"],)
                    ).fetchone()
                    if existing:
                        continue
                    cur.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO incidents "
                        "(id, fingerprint, title, severity, status, owner, "
                        "alert_count, version, escalation_level, created_at, "
                        "updated_at, sla_deadline, claim_worker, claim_expires_at) "
                        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        (
                            record["id"],
                            record["fingerprint"],
                            record["title"],
                            record["severity"],
                            record["status"],
                            record["owner"],
                            record["alert_count"],
                            record["version"],
                            record["escalation_level"],
                            record["created_at"],
                            record["updated_at"],
                            record["sla_deadline"],
                            record.get("claim_worker"),
                            record.get("claim_expires_at"),
                        ),
                    )
                    imported += 1
                elif record["kind"] == "event":
                    existing = cur.execute(
                        "SELECT 1 FROM audit_events WHERE id = ?", (record["id"],)
                    ).fetchone()
                    if existing:
                        continue
                    cur.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO audit_events "
                        "(id, incident_id, type, timestamp, details) "
                        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        (
                            record["id"],
                            record["incident_id"],
                            record["type"],

import json
import re
import time
from dataclasses import asdict
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

from .models import (
    Incident,
    IncidentNotFound,
    InvalidTransition,
    Severity,
    VersionConflict,
)
from .sqlite_store import SQLiteIncidentStore

STATIC_DIR = Path(__file__).with_name("static")


def _incident_to_dict(incident: Incident) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": incident.id,
        "fingerprint": incident.fingerprint,
        "title": incident.title,
        "severity": incident.severity.value,
        "status": incident.status.value,
        "owner": incident.owner,
        "alert_count": incident.alert_count,
        "version": incident.version,
        "escalation_level": incident.escalation_level,

def _event_to_dict(event: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:

        "id": event.id,
        "incident_id": event.incident_id,
        "type": event.type,
        "timestamp": event.timestamp,
        "details": event.details,
    }


def create_server(
    store: SQLiteIncidentStore,
    host: str = "127.0.0.1",
    port: int = 8080,
) -> ThreadingHTTPServer:
    """Construct and bind a server without starting its request loop."""

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self) -> None:
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            path = parsed.path
            if path == "/api/incidents":
                qs = parse_qs(parsed.query)
                incidents = store.list(
                    status=qs.get("status", [None])[0],
                    severity=qs.get("severity", [None])[0],
                    owner=qs.get("owner", [None])[0],
                )
                self._json(200, [_incident_to_dict(i) for i in incidents])
                return
            if path == "/api/summary":
                self._json(200, self._summary())
                return
            m = re.match(r"^/api/incidents/([^/]+)$", path)
            if m:
                incident = store.get(m.group(1))
                if incident is None:
                    self._json(404, {"error": "incident not found"})
                    return
                events = store.events(incident.id)
                payload = _incident_to_dict(incident)
                payload["events"] = [_event_to_dict(e) for e in events]
                self._json(200, payload)
                return
            if path in {"/", "/index.html"}:
                self._file("index.html", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
                return
            if path == "/app.js":
                self._file("app.js", "text/javascript; charset=utf-8")
                return
            if path == "/styles.css":
                self._file("styles.css", "text/css; charset=utf-8")
                return
            self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})

        def do_POST(self) -> None:
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            path = parsed.path
            if path == "/api/alerts":
                try:
                    payload = self._body()
                    fingerprint = payload.get("fingerprint")
                    if not fingerprint:
                        self._json(400, {"error": "fingerprint is required"})
                        return
                    title = payload.get("title", "")
                    if not title:
                        self._json(400, {"error": "title is required"})
                        return
                    severity = payload.get("severity", "P3")
                    try:
                        Severity(severity)
                    except ValueError:
                        self._json(400, {"error": f"invalid severity: {severity}"})
                        return
                    incident, created = store.ingest_alert(
                        fingerprint=fingerprint,
                        title=title,
                        severity=severity,
                        source=payload.get("source", "unknown"),
                        details=payload.get("details"),
                        idempotency_key=payload.get("idempotency_key"),
                    )
                    self._json(201 if created else 200, _incident_to_dict(incident))
                except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                    self._json(400, {"error": f"invalid JSON: {exc}"})
                return

                try:
                    payload = self._body()
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    payload = {}
                worker_id = payload.get("worker_id", "api")
                max_incidents = payload.get("max_incidents")
                incident = store.claim_due_escalation(worker_id)
                if incident is None:
                    self._json(200, None)
                    return
                result = store.complete_escalation(incident.id, worker_id)
                self._json(200, _incident_to_dict(result))
                return
            self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})

            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            m = re.match(r"^/api/incidents/([^/]+)$", parsed.path)
            if not m:
                self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})
                return
            incident_id = m.group(1)
            try:
                payload = self._body()
            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                self._json(400, {"error": f"invalid JSON: {exc}"})
                return
            expected_version = payload.get("expected_version")
            if expected_version is None:
                self._json(400, {"error": "expected_version is required"})
                return
            try:
                expected_version = int(expected_version)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                self._json(400, {"error": "expected_version must be an integer"})
                return
            status = payload.get("status")
            if status is not None:
                try:
                    Severity(payload.get("severity", ""))
                except ValueError:
                    pass
            try:
                incident = store.update(
                    incident_id,
                    expected_version=expected_version,
                    owner=payload.get("owner"),
                    status=status,
                    idempotency_key=payload.get("idempotency_key"),
                )
            except IncidentNotFound:
                self._json(404, {"error": "incident not found"})
                return
            except VersionConflict as exc:
                self._json(409, {"error": str(exc), "expected": exc.expected, "actual": exc.actual})
                return
            except InvalidTransition as exc:
                self._json(422, {"error": str(exc)})
                return
            self._json(200, _incident_to_dict(incident))

        def _body(self) -> dict:
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
            if length == 0:
                return {}
            return json.loads(self.rfile.read(length))

        def _file(self, name: str, content_type: str) -> None:
            body = (STATIC_DIR / name).read_bytes()
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)

        def _json(self, status: int, value: object) -> None:
            body = json.dumps(value, default=str).encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)

        def _summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
            incidents = store.list()
            total = len(incidents)
            by_status: dict[str, int] = {}
            by_severity: dict[str, int] = {}
            for inc in incidents:
                by_status[inc.status.value] = by_status.get(inc.status.value, 0) + 1
                by_severity[inc.severity.value] = (
                    by_severity.get(inc.severity.value, 0) + 1
                )
            return {
                "total": total,
                "by_status": by_status,
                "by_severity": by_severity,
            }

        def log_message(self, format: str, *args: object) -> None:
            return

    return ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), Handler)

    Incident,

    InvalidTransition,
    Severity,
    VersionConflict,
)
from .sqlite_store import SQLiteIncidentStore

STATIC_DIR = Path(__file__).with_name("static")


def _incident_to_dict(incident: Incident) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": incident.id,
        "fingerprint": incident.fingerprint,
        "title": incident.title,
        "severity": incident.severity.value,
        "status": incident.status.value,
        "owner": incident.owner,
        "alert_count": incident.alert_count,
        "version": incident.version,
        "escalation_level": incident.escalation_level,
        "created_at": incident.created_at,
        "updated_at": incident.updated_at,
        "sla_deadline": incident.sla_deadline,
    }


def _event_to_dict(event: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": event.id,
        "incident_id": event.incident_id,
        "type": event.type,
        "timestamp": event.timestamp,
        "details": event.details,
    }


def create_server(
    store: SQLiteIncidentStore,
    host: str = "127.0.0.1",
    port: int = 8080,
) -> ThreadingHTTPServer:
    """Construct and bind a server without starting its request loop."""

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self) -> None:
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            path = parsed.path
            if path == "/api/incidents":
                qs = parse_qs(parsed.query)
                incidents = store.list(
                    status=qs.get("status", [None])[0],
                    severity=qs.get("severity", [None])[0],
                    owner=qs.get("owner", [None])[0],
                )
                self._json(200, [_incident_to_dict(i) for i in incidents])
                return
            if path == "/api/summary":
                self._json(200, self._summary())
                return
            m = re.match(r"^/api/incidents/([^/]+)$", path)
            if m:
                incident = store.get(m.group(1))
                if incident is None:
                    self._json(404, {"error": "incident not found"})
                    return
                events = store.events(incident.id)
                payload = _incident_to_dict(incident)
                payload["events"] = [_event_to_dict(e) for e in events]
                self._json(200, payload)
                return
            if path in {"/", "/index.html"}:
                self._file("index.html", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
                return
            if path == "/app.js":
                self._file("app.js", "text/javascript; charset=utf-8")
                return
            if path == "/styles.css":
                self._file("styles.css", "text/css; charset=utf-8")
                return
            self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})

        def do_POST(self) -> None:
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            path = parsed.path
            if path == "/api/alerts":
                try:
                    payload = self._body()
                    fingerprint = payload.get("fingerprint")
                    if not fingerprint:
                        self._json(400, {"error": "fingerprint is required"})
                        return
                    title = payload.get("title", "")
                    if not title:
                        self._json(400, {"error": "title is required"})
                        return
                    severity = payload.get("severity", "P3")
                    try:
                        Severity(severity)
                    except ValueError:
                        self._json(400, {"error": f"invalid severity: {severity}"})
                        return

                        fingerprint=fingerprint,
                        title=title,
                        severity=severity,

                        idempotency_key=payload.get("idempotency_key"),
                    )
                    self._json(201 if created else 200, _incident_to_dict(incident))
                except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                    self._json(400, {"error": f"invalid JSON: {exc}"})
                return

                try:
                    payload = self._body()
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    payload = {}
                worker_id = payload.get("worker_id", "api")
                max_incidents = payload.get("max_incidents")
                incident = store.claim_due_escalation(worker_id)
                if incident is None:
                    self._json(200, None)
                    return
                result = store.complete_escalation(incident.id, worker_id)
                self._json(200, _incident_to_dict(result))
                return

                payload = self._body()
            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                self._json(400, {"error": f"invalid JSON: {exc}"})

                self._json(400, {"error": "expected_version is required"})
                return

                expected_version = int(expected_version)

                self._json(400, {"error": "expected_version must be an integer"})

            by_severity: dict[str, int] = {}
            for inc in incidents:

"""Standard-library HTTP server for the incident operations interface."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import time
from dataclasses import asdict
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

from .models import (
    Incident,
    IncidentNotFound,
    InvalidTransition,
    Severity,
    VersionConflict,
)
from .sqlite_store import SQLiteIncidentStore

STATIC_DIR = Path(__file__).with_name("static")


def _incident_to_dict(incident: Incident) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": incident.id,
        "fingerprint": incident.fingerprint,
        "title": incident.title,
        "severity": incident.severity.value,
        "status": incident.status.value,
        "owner": incident.owner,
        "alert_count": incident.alert_count,
        "version": incident.version,
        "escalation_level": incident.escalation_level,
        "created_at": incident.created_at,
        "updated_at": incident.updated_at,
        "sla_deadline": incident.sla_deadline,
    }


def _event_to_dict(event: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": event.id,
        "incident_id": event.incident_id,
        "type": event.type,
        "timestamp": event.timestamp,
        "details": event.details,
    }


def create_server(
    store: SQLiteIncidentStore,
    host: str = "127.0.0.1",
    port: int = 8080,
) -> ThreadingHTTPServer:
    """Construct and bind a server without starting its request loop."""

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self) -> None:
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            path = parsed.path
            if path == "/api/incidents":
                qs = parse_qs(parsed.query)
                incidents = store.list(
                    status=qs.get("status", [None])[0],
                    severity=qs.get("severity", [None])[0],
                    owner=qs.get("owner", [None])[0],
                )
                self._json(200, [_incident_to_dict(i) for i in incidents])
                return
            if path == "/api/summary":
                self._json(200, self._summary())
                return
            m = re.match(r"^/api/incidents/([^/]+)$", path)
            if m:
                incident = store.get(m.group(1))
                if incident is None:
                    self._json(404, {"error": "incident not found"})
                    return
                events = store.events(incident.id)
                payload = _incident_to_dict(incident)
                payload["events"] = [_event_to_dict(e) for e in events]
                self._json(200, payload)
                return
            if path in {"/", "/index.html"}:
                self._file("index.html", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
                return
            if path == "/app.js":
                self._file("app.js", "text/javascript; charset=utf-8")
                return
            if path == "/styles.css":
                self._file("styles.css", "text/css; charset=utf-8")
                return
            self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})

        def do_POST(self) -> None:
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            path = parsed.path
            if path == "/api/alerts":
                try:
                    payload = self._body()
                    fingerprint = payload.get("fingerprint")
                    if not fingerprint:
                        self._json(400, {"error": "fingerprint is required"})
                        return
                    title = payload.get("title", "")
                    if not title:
                        self._json(400, {"error": "title is required"})
                        return
                    severity = payload.get("severity", "P3")
                    try:
                        Severity(severity)
                    except ValueError:
                        self._json(400, {"error": f"invalid severity: {severity}"})
                        return
                    incident, created = store.ingest_alert(
                        fingerprint=fingerprint,
                        title=title,
                        severity=severity,
                        source=payload.get("source", "unknown"),
                        details=payload.get("details"),
                        idempotency_key=payload.get("idempotency_key"),
                    )
                    self._json(201 if created else 200, _incident_to_dict(incident))
                except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                    self._json(400, {"error": f"invalid JSON: {exc}"})
                return
            if path == "/api/escalations/run":
                try:
                    payload = self._body()
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    payload = {}
                worker_id = payload.get("worker_id", "api")
                max_incidents = payload.get("max_incidents")
                incident = store.claim_due_escalation(worker_id)
                if incident is None:
                    self._json(200, None)
                    return
                result = store.complete_escalation(incident.id, worker_id)
                self._json(200, _incident_to_dict(result))
                return
            self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})

        def do_PATCH(self) -> None:
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            m = re.match(r"^/api/incidents/([^/]+)$", parsed.path)
            if not m:
                self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})
                return
            incident_id = m.group(1)
            try:
                payload = self._body()
            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                self._json(400, {"error": f"invalid JSON: {exc}"})
                return
            expected_version = payload.get("expected_version")
            if expected_version is None:
                self._json(400, {"error": "expected_version is required"})
                return
            try:
                expected_version = int(expected_version)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                self._json(400, {"error": "expected_version must be an integer"})
                return
            status = payload.get("status")
            if status is not None:
                try:
                    Severity(payload.get("severity", ""))
                except ValueError:
                    pass
            try:
                incident = store.update(
                    incident_id,
                    expected_version=expected_version,
                    owner=payload.get("owner"),
                    status=status,
                    idempotency_key=payload.get("idempotency_key"),
                )
            except IncidentNotFound:
                self._json(404, {"error": "incident not found"})
                return
            except VersionConflict as exc:
                self._json(409, {"error": str(exc), "expected": exc.expected, "actual": exc.actual})
                return
            except InvalidTransition as exc:
                self._json(422, {"error": str(exc)})
                return
            self._json(200, _incident_to_dict(incident))

        def _body(self) -> dict:
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
            if length == 0:
                return {}
            return json.loads(self.rfile.read(length))

        def _file(self, name: str, content_type: str) -> None:
            body = (STATIC_DIR / name).read_bytes()
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)

        def _json(self, status: int, value: object) -> None:
            body = json.dumps(value, default=str).encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)

        def _summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
            incidents = store.list()
            total = len(incidents)
            by_status: dict[str, int] = {}
            by_severity: dict[str, int] = {}
            for inc in incidents:
                by_status[inc.status.value] = by_status.get(inc.status.value, 0) + 1
                by_severity[inc.severity.value] = (
                    by_severity.get(inc.severity.value, 0) + 1
                )
            return {
                "total": total,
                "by_status": by_status,
                "by_severity": by_severity,
            }

        def log_message(self, format: str, *args: object) -> None:
            return

    return ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), Handler)

"""Command line entry point for the incident operations application."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from typing import Any

from .escalation import EscalationWorker
from .sqlite_store import SQLiteIncidentStore
from .web import _incident_to_dict, create_server


def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    result = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="incident_ops")
    result.add_argument("--db", required=True, help="database path")
    subcommands = result.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    serve = subcommands.add_parser("serve")
    serve.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    serve.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8080)
    subcommands.add_parser("ingest").add_argument("alert", help="JSON alert payload")
    list_cmd = subcommands.add_parser("list")
    list_cmd.add_argument("--status", default=None)
    list_cmd.add_argument("--severity", default=None)
    list_cmd.add_argument("--owner", default=None)
    subcommands.add_parser("update").add_argument("incident_id")
    subcommands.parser_update = None
    escalate = subcommands.add_parser("escalate")
    escalate.add_argument("--worker-id", default="cli")
    escalate.add_argument("--max-incidents", type=int, default=None)
    subcommands.add_parser("export")
    subcommands.add_parser("import")
    return result


def _parse_update_parser(subcommands: argparse._SubParsersAction) -> None:
    update = subcommands.add_parser("update")
    update.add_argument("incident_id")
    update.add_argument("update", help="JSON update payload")


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parser().parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "serve":
        store = SQLiteIncidentStore(args.db)
        server = create_server(store, args.host, args.port)
        try:
            server.serve_forever()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            pass
        finally:
            server.server_close()
            store.close()
        return 0
    store = SQLiteIncidentStore(args.db)
    try:
        if args.command == "ingest":
            try:
                payload = json.loads(args.alert)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": f"invalid JSON: {exc}"}))
                return 2
            try:
                incident, created = store.ingest_alert(
                    fingerprint=payload["fingerprint"],
                    title=payload.get("title", ""),
                    severity=payload.get("severity", "P3"),
                    source=payload.get("source", "unknown"),
                    details=payload.get("details"),
                    idempotency_key=payload.get("idempotency_key"),
                )
            except KeyError as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": f"missing field: {exc}"}))
                return 2
            except ValueError as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": str(exc)}))
                return 2
            result = _incident_to_dict(incident)
            result["created"] = created
            print(json.dumps(result))
            return 0
        if args.command == "list":
            incidents = store.list(
                status=args.status, severity=args.severity, owner=args.owner
            )
            print(json.dumps([_incident_to_dict(i) for i in incidents]))
            return 0
        if args.command == "update":
            incident_id = args.incident_id
            try:
                payload = json.loads(args.update)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": f"invalid JSON: {exc}"}))
                return 2
            try:
                incident = store.update(
                    incident_id,
                    expected_version=int(payload["expected_version"]),
                    owner=payload.get("owner"),
                    status=payload.get("status"),
                    idempotency_key=payload.get("idempotency_key"),
                )
            except KeyError as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": f"missing field: {exc}"}))
                return 2
            except ValueError as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": str(exc)}))
                return 2
            except Exception as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": str(exc)}))
                return 1
            print(json.dumps(_incident_to_dict(incident)))
            return 0
        if args.command == "escalate":
            worker = EscalationWorker(store, args.worker_id)
            results = worker.run_until_idle(max_incidents=args.max_incidents)
            print(json.dumps([_incident_to_dict(i) for i in results]))
            return 0
        if args.command == "export":
            for record in store.export_records():
                print(json.dumps(record))
            return 0
        if args.command == "import":
            records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for line in sys.stdin:
                line = line.strip()
                if not line:
                    continue
                try:
                    records.append(json.loads(line))
                except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                    print(json.dumps({"error": f"invalid JSON line: {exc}"}))
                    return 2
            count = store.import_records(records)
            print(json.dumps({"imported": count}))
            return 0
    finally:
        store.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Command line entry point for the incident operations application."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from typing import Any

from .escalation import EscalationWorker
from .sqlite_store import SQLiteIncidentStore
from .web import _incident_to_dict, create_server


def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    result = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="incident_ops")
    result.add_argument("--db", required=True, help="database path")
    subcommands = result.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    serve = subcommands.add_parser("serve")
    serve.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    serve.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8080)
    subcommands.add_parser("ingest").add_argument("alert", help="JSON alert payload")
    list_cmd = subcommands.add_parser("list")
    list_cmd.add_argument("--status", default=None)
    list_cmd.add_argument("--severity", default=None)
    list_cmd.add_argument("--owner", default=None)
    subcommands.add_parser("update").add_argument("incident_id")
    subcommands.parser_update = None
    escalate = subcommands.add_parser("escalate")
    escalate.add_argument("--worker-id", default="cli")
    escalate.add_argument("--max-incidents", type=int, default=None)
    subcommands.add_parser("export")
    subcommands.add_parser("import")
    return result


def _parse_update_parser(subcommands: argparse._SubParsersAction) -> None:
    update = subcommands.add_parser("update")
    update.add_argument("incident_id")
    update.add_argument("update", help="JSON update payload")


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parser().parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "serve":
        store = SQLiteIncidentStore(args.db)
        server = create_server(store, args.host, args.port)
        try:
            server.serve_forever()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            pass
        finally:
            server.server_close()
            store.close()
        return 0
    store = SQLiteIncidentStore(args.db)
    try:
        if args.command == "ingest":
            try:
                payload = json.loads(args.alert)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": f"invalid JSON: {exc}"}))
                return 2
            try:
                incident, created = store.ingest_alert(
                    fingerprint=payload["fingerprint"],
                    title=payload.get("title", ""),
                    severity=payload.get("severity", "P3"),
                    source=payload.get("source", "unknown"),
                    details=payload.get("details"),
                    idempotency_key=payload.get("idempotency_key"),
                )
            except KeyError as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": f"missing field: {exc}"}))
                return 2
            except ValueError as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": str(exc)}))
                return 2
            result = _incident_to_dict(incident)
            result["created"] = created
            print(json.dumps(result))
            return 0
        if args.command == "list":
            incidents = store.list(
                status=args.status, severity=args.severity, owner=args.owner
            )
            print(json.dumps([_incident_to_dict(i) for i in incidents]))
            return 0
        if args.command == "update":
            incident_id = args.incident_id
            try:
                payload = json.loads(args.update)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": f"invalid JSON: {exc}"}))
                return 2
            try:
                incident = store.update(
                    incident_id,
                    expected_version=int(payload["expected_version"]),
                    owner=payload.get("owner"),
                    status=payload.get("status"),
                    idempotency_key=payload.get("idempotency_key"),
                )
            except KeyError as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": f"missing field: {exc}"}))
                return 2
            except ValueError as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": str(exc)}))
                return 2
            except Exception as exc:
                print(json.dumps({"error": str(exc)}))
                return 1
            print(json.dumps(_incident_to_dict(incident)))
            return 0
        if args.command == "escalate":
            worker = EscalationWorker(store, args.worker_id)
            results = worker.run_until_idle(max_incidents=args.max_incidents)
            print(json.dumps([_incident_to_dict(i) for i in results]))
            return 0
        if args.command == "export":
            for record in store.export_records():
                print(json.dumps(record))
            return 0
        if args.command == "import":
            records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for line in sys.stdin:
                line = line.strip()
                if not line:
                    continue
                try:
                    records.append(json.loads(line))
                except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                    print(json.dumps({"error": f"invalid JSON line: {exc}"}))
                    return 2
            count = store.import_records(records)
            print(json.dumps({"imported": count}))
            return 0
    finally:
        store.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Tests for the SQLite-backed incident store."""

from __future__ import annotations

import tempfile
import threading
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from incident_ops.models import (
    AuditEvent,
    Incident,
    IncidentNotFound,
    IncidentStatus,
    InvalidTransition,
    Severity,
    VersionConflict,
)
from incident_ops.sqlite_store import SQLiteIncidentStore


@pytest.fixture()
def db_path(tmp_path: Path) -> str:
    return str(tmp_path / "test.db")


def _store(db_path: str, **kwargs) -> SQLiteIncidentStore:
    return SQLiteIncidentStore(db_path, **kwargs)


def test_create_initializes_database(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    assert Path(db_path).exists()
    store.close()


def test_separate_stores_share_state(db_path: str) -> None:
    store1 = _store(db_path)
    incident, created = store1.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    store1.close()
    assert created is True
    store2 = _store(db_path)
    fetched = store2.get(incident.id)
    assert fetched is not None
    assert fetched.id == incident.id
    store2.close()


def test_ingest_first_alert_creates_incident(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, created = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    assert created is True
    assert incident.status is IncidentStatus.OPEN
    assert incident.alert_count == 1
    assert incident.version == 1
    assert incident.escalation_level == 0
    assert incident.fingerprint == "fp-1"
    assert incident.sla_deadline == 100.0 + 60
    events = store.events(incident.id)
    assert len(events) == 1
    assert events[0].type == "created"
    store.close()


def test_duplicate_alert_merges(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, created = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    assert created is True
    merged, created2 = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=150.0)
    assert created2 is False
    assert merged.id == incident.id
    assert merged.alert_count == 2
    assert merged.version == 2
    assert merged.updated_at == 150.0
    events = store.events(incident.id)
    assert len(events) == 2
    assert events[1].type == "duplicate_alert"
    store.close()


def test_resolved_incident_not_reused(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path, dedupe_window=1000)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    store.update(incident.id, expected_version=1, status="resolved", now=110.0)
    new_incident, created = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=120.0)
    assert created is True
    assert new_incident.id != incident.id
    store.close()


def test_alert_outside_dedupe_window_creates_new(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path, dedupe_window=50)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    new_incident, created = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=200.0)
    assert created is True
    assert new_incident.id != incident.id
    store.close()


def test_idempotency_key_returns_original(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, created = store.ingest_alert(
        "fp-1", "DB down", "P1", idempotency_key="key-1", now=100.0
    )
    assert created is True
    assert incident.version == 1
    result, created2 = store.ingest_alert(
        "fp-1", "DB down", "P1", idempotency_key="key-1", now=120.0
    )
    assert created2 is True
    assert result.id == incident.id
    assert result.version == 1
    events = store.events(incident.id)
    assert len(events) == 1
    store.close()


def test_idempotency_key_for_duplicate(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    merged, created = store.ingest_alert(
        "fp-1", "DB down", "P1", idempotency_key="key-2", now=120.0
    )
    assert created is False
    assert merged.version == 2
    result, created2 = store.ingest_alert(
        "fp-1", "DB down", "P1", idempotency_key="key-2", now=130.0
    )
    assert created2 is False
    assert result.id == incident.id
    assert result.version == 2
    events = store.events(incident.id)
    assert len(events) == 2
    store.close()


def test_update_owner(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    updated = store.update(
        incident.id, expected_version=1, owner="Alice", now=110.0
    )
    assert updated.owner == "Alice"
    assert updated.version == 2
    events = store.events(incident.id)
    assert any(e.type == "owner_changed" for e in events)
    store.close()


def test_update_status_acknowledge(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    updated = store.update(
        incident.id, expected_version=1, status="acknowledged", now=110.0
    )
    assert updated.status is IncidentStatus.ACKNOWLEDGED
    assert updated.version == 2
    events = store.events(incident.id)
    assert any(e.type == "status_changed" for e in events)
    store.close()


def test_update_status_resolve(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    store.update(incident.id, expected_version=1, status="acknowledged", now=110.0)
    updated = store.update(incident.id, expected_version=2, status="resolved", now=120.0)
    assert updated.status is IncidentStatus.RESOLVED
    store.close()


def test_invalid_transition(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    store.update(incident.id, expected_version=1, status="acknowledged", now=110.0)
    with pytest.raises(InvalidTransition):
        store.update(incident.id, expected_version=2, status="open", now=120.0)
    store.close()


def test_version_conflict(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    store.update(incident.id, expected_version=1, owner="Alice", now=110.0)
    with pytest.raises(VersionConflict):
        store.update(incident.id, expected_version=1, owner="Bob", now=120.0)
    store.close()


def test_update_missing_incident(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    with pytest.raises(IncidentNotFound):
        store.update("nope", expected_version=1, owner="Alice")
    store.close()


def test_list_with_filters(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    store.ingest_alert("fp-2", "API slow", "P2", now=110.0)
    store.ingest_alert("fp-3", "Cache miss", "P3", now=120.0)
    inc1, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=130.0)
    store.update(inc1.id, expected_version=2, status="resolved", now=140.0)
    all_incidents = store.list()
    assert len(all_incidents) == 3
    p1_only = store.list(severity="P1")
    assert len(p1_only) == 1
    resolved = store.list(status="resolved")
    assert len(resolved) == 1
    open_incidents = store.list(status="open")
    assert len(open_incidents) == 2
    store.close()


def test_immutable_snapshots(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    snapshot = store.get(incident.id)
    store.update(incident.id, expected_version=1, owner="Alice", now=110.0)
    assert snapshot.owner is None
    assert snapshot.version == 1
    assert snapshot is not None
    store.close()


def test_audit_events_ordered(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    store.update(incident.id, expected_version=1, owner="Alice", now=110.0)
    store.update(incident.id, expected_version=2, status="acknowledged", now=120.0)
    events = store.events(incident.id)
    assert len(events) == 3
    assert events[0].type == "created"
    assert events[1].type == "owner_changed"
    assert events[2].type == "status_changed"
    assert all(isinstance(e, AuditEvent) for e in events)
    ids = [e.id for e in events]
    assert ids == sorted(ids)
    store.close()


def test_sla_deadlines_by_severity(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    expected = {"P1": 60, "P2": 300, "P3": 900, "P4": 3600}
    for sev, delta in expected.items():
        inc, _ = store.ingest_alert(f"fp-{sev}", "test", sev, now=100.0)
        assert inc.sla_deadline == 100.0 + delta
    store.close()


def test_claim_due_escalation(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    claimed = store.claim_due_escalation("worker-1", now=200.0)
    assert claimed is not None
    assert claimed.id == incident.id
    claimed2 = store.claim_due_escalation("worker-2", now=201.0)
    assert claimed2 is None
    store.close()


def test_complete_escalation(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    claimed = store.claim_due_escalation("worker-1", now=200.0)
    assert claimed is not None
    completed = store.complete_escalation(incident.id, "worker-1", now=210.0)
    assert completed.escalation_level == 1
    assert completed.version == 2
    assert completed.sla_deadline == 210.0 + 60
    events = store.events(incident.id)
    types = [e.type for e in events]
    assert "escalation_claimed" in types
    assert "escalated" in types
    store.close()


def test_complete_escalation_wrong_worker(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    store.claim_due_escalation("worker-1", now=200.0)
    with pytest.raises(VersionConflict):
        store.complete_escalation(incident.id, "worker-2", now=210.0)
    store.close()


def test_recover_expired_claims(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path, lease_seconds=10)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    store.claim_due_escalation("worker-1", now=200.0)
    recovered = store.recover_expired_claims(now=220.0)
    assert recovered == 1
    claimed = store.claim_due_escalation("worker-2", now=221.0)
    assert claimed is not None
    assert claimed.id == incident.id
    store.close()


def test_resolved_never_claimed(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = _store(db_path)
    incident, _ = store.ingest_alert("fp-1", "DB down", "P1", now=100.0)
    store.update(incident.id, expected_version=1, status="resolved", now=110.0)
    claimed = store.claim_due_escalation("worker-1", now=500.0)
    assert claimed is None
    store.close()


def test_concurrent_ingestion_creates_single_incident(db_path: str) -> None:

    store.ingest_alert("fp-2", "API slow", "P2", now=100.0)

"""Tests for the HTTP API."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError

import pytest

from incident_ops.sqlite_store import SQLiteIncidentStore
from incident_ops.web import create_server


@pytest.fixture()
def db_path(tmp_path: Path) -> str:
    return str(tmp_path / "http.db")


@pytest.fixture()
def server(db_path: str):
    store = SQLiteIncidentStore(db_path)
    srv = create_server(store, "127.0.0.1", 0)
    port = srv.server_address[1]
    thread = threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
    yield base
    srv.shutdown()
    thread.join(timeout=5)
    srv.server_close()
    store.close()


def _request(base: str, method: str, path: str, body=None) -> tuple[int, dict | list | None]:
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = Request(base + path, data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    try:
        with urlopen(req, timeout=5) as resp:
            return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read())
    except HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, json.loads(e.read())


def test_post_alerts_creates_incident(server: str) -> None:
    status, data = _request(
        server, "POST", "/api/alerts",
        {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"},
    )
    assert status == 201
    assert data["status"] == "open"
    assert data["severity"] == "P1"
    assert data["alert_count"] == 1


def test_post_alerts_merges_duplicate(server: str) -> None:
    _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    status, data = _request(
        server, "POST", "/api/alerts",
        {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"},
    )
    assert status == 200
    assert data["alert_count"] == 2


def test_post_alerts_missing_fingerprint(server: str) -> None:
    status, data = _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    assert status == 400
    assert "fingerprint" in data["error"]


def test_post_alerts_invalid_severity(server: str) -> None:
    status, data = _request(
        server, "POST", "/api/alerts",
        {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P9"},
    )
    assert status == 400


def test_get_incidents(server: str) -> None:
    _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    status, data = _request(server, "GET", "/api/incidents")
    assert status == 200
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    assert len(data) == 1


def test_get_incidents_with_filter(server: str) -> None:
    _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-2", "title": "API slow", "severity": "P2"})
    status, data = _request(server, "GET", "/api/incidents?severity=P1")
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data) == 1
    assert data[0]["severity"] == "P1"


def test_get_incident_detail(server: str) -> None:
    _, incident = _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    status, data = _request(server, "GET", f"/api/incidents/{incident['id']}")
    assert status == 200
    assert "events" in data
    assert len(data["events"]) == 1


def test_get_incident_not_found(server: str) -> None:
    status, data = _request(server, "GET", "/api/incidents/nope")
    assert status == 404


def test_patch_incident_update_owner(server: str) -> None:
    _, incident = _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    status, data = _request(
        server, "PATCH", f"/api/incidents/{incident['id']}",
        {"expected_version": 1, "owner": "Alice"},
    )
    assert status == 200
    assert data["owner"] == "Alice"
    assert data["version"] == 2


def test_patch_incident_version_conflict(server: str) -> None:
    _, incident = _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    _request(server, "PATCH", f"/api/incidents/{incident['id']}", {"expected_version": 1, "owner": "Alice"})
    status, data = _request(
        server, "PATCH", f"/api/incidents/{incident['id']}",
        {"expected_version": 1, "owner": "Bob"},
    )
    assert status == 409


def test_patch_incident_invalid_transition(server: str) -> None:
    _, incident = _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    status, data = _request(
        server, "PATCH", f"/api/incidents/{incident['id']}",
        {"expected_version": 1, "status": "open"},
    )
    assert status == 422


def test_patch_missing_expected_version(server: str) -> None:
    _, incident = _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    status, data = _request(
        server, "PATCH", f"/api/incidents/{incident['id']}",
        {"owner": "Alice"},
    )
    assert status == 400


def test_get_summary(server: str) -> None:
    _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-2", "title": "API slow", "severity": "P2"})
    status, data = _request(server, "GET", "/api/summary")
    assert status == 200
    assert data["total"] == 2
    assert "by_status" in data
    assert "by_severity" in data


def test_post_escalation_run(server: str) -> None:
    _, incident = _request(server, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    status, data = _request(server, "POST", "/api/escalations/run", {})
    assert status == 200


def test_state_survives_restart(db_path: str) -> None:
    store = SQLiteIncidentStore(db_path)
    srv = create_server(store, "127.0.0.1", 0)
    port = srv.server_address[1]
    thread = threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
    _request(base, "POST", "/api/alerts", {"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    srv.shutdown()
    thread.join(timeout=5)
    srv.server_close()
    store.close()

    store2 = SQLiteIncidentStore(db_path)
    srv2 = create_server(store2, "127.0.0.1", 0)
    port2 = srv2.server_address[1]
    thread2 = threading.Thread(target=srv2.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread2.start()
    base2 = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port2}"
    status, data = _request(base2, "GET", "/api/incidents")
    srv2.shutdown()
    thread2.join(timeout=5)
    srv2.server_close()
    store2.close()
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data) == 1

"""Tests for the CLI across separate processes."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

CLI = [sys.executable, "-m", "incident_ops.cli"]


def _run(db: str, *args: str, stdin: str | None = None) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
    cmd = CLI + ["--db", db] + list(args)
    proc = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        input=stdin,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=10,
        cwd=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent),
    )
    return proc.returncode, proc.stdout, proc.stderr


def test_ingest_and_list(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "cli.db")
    rc, out, err = _run(db, "ingest", json.dumps({"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"}))
    assert rc == 0, err
    data = json.loads(out)
    assert data["severity"] == "P1"
    assert data["created"] is True

    rc, out, err = _run(db, "list")
    assert rc == 0, err
    incidents = json.loads(out)
    assert len(incidents) == 1


def test_ingest_duplicate(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "cli.db")
    alert = json.dumps({"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"})
    _run(db, "ingest", alert)
    rc, out, err = _run(db, "ingest", alert)
    assert rc == 0, err
    data = json.loads(out)
    assert data["created"] is False
    assert data["alert_count"] == 2


def test_update_incident(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "cli.db")
    rc, out, _ = _run(db, "ingest", json.dumps({"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"}))
    incident_id = json.loads(out)["id"]
    rc, out, err = _run(db, "update", incident_id, json.dumps({"expected_version": 1, "owner": "Alice", "status": "acknowledged"}))
    assert rc == 0, err
    data = json.loads(out)
    assert data["owner"] == "Alice"
    assert data["status"] == "acknowledged"
    assert data["version"] == 2


def test_update_version_conflict(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "cli.db")
    rc, out, _ = _run(db, "ingest", json.dumps({"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"}))
    incident_id = json.loads(out)["id"]
    _run(db, "update", incident_id, json.dumps({"expected_version": 1, "owner": "Alice"}))
    rc, out, err = _run(db, "update", incident_id, json.dumps({"expected_version": 1, "owner": "Bob"}))
    assert rc != 0
    data = json.loads(out)
    assert "error" in data


def test_escalate(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "cli.db")
    _run(db, "ingest", json.dumps({"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"}))
    rc, out, err = _run(db, "escalate", "--worker-id", "w1")
    assert rc == 0, err
    data = json.loads(out)
    assert len(data) == 1
    assert data[0]["escalation_level"] == 1


def test_export_import(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "cli.db")
    _run(db, "ingest", json.dumps({"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"}))
    _run(db, "ingest", json.dumps({"fingerprint": "fp-1", "title": "DB down", "severity": "P1"}))
    rc, out, err = _run(db, "export")
    assert rc == 0, err
    lines = [l for l in out.strip().split("\n") if l]
    assert len(lines) >= 2

    new_db = str(tmp_path / "imported.db")
    rc, out, err = _run(new_db, "import", stdin=out)
    assert rc == 0, err
    data = json.loads(out)
    assert data["imported"] > 0

    rc, out2, err = _run(new_db, "import", stdin=out)
    assert rc == 0, err
    data2 = json.loads(out2)
    assert data2["imported"] == 0


def test_invalid_json(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "cli.db")
    rc, out, err = _run(db, "ingest", "{bad json")
    assert rc != 0
    data = json.loads(out)
    assert "error" in data


def test_serve_and_request(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "serve.db")
    proc = subprocess.Popen(
        CLI + ["--db", db, "serve", "--port", "0"],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
        cwd=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent),
    )
    try:
        import time
        time.sleep(0.5)
        from urllib.request import urlopen
        resp = urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/summary", timeout=2)
        assert resp.status == 200
    finally:
        proc.terminate()
        proc.wait(timeout=5)
