"""Durable SQLite-backed incident store."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
import time
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from .models import (
    SLA_SECONDS,
    VALID_TRANSITIONS,
    AuditEvent,
    Incident,
    IncidentNotFound,
    IncidentStatus,
    InvalidTransition,
    Severity,
    VersionConflict,
)

DEFAULT_DEDUPE_WINDOW = 300.0
DEFAULT_LEASE_SECONDS = 30.0

_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incidents (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    owner TEXT,
    alert_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    escalation_level INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
    sla_deadline REAL NOT NULL,
    claim_worker TEXT,
    claim_expires_at REAL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_incidents_fingerprint
    ON incidents(fingerprint);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_incidents_status
    ON incidents(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_incidents_sla
    ON incidents(sla_deadline);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    incident_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    details TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (incident_id) REFERENCES incidents(id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_incident
    ON audit_events(incident_id, id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    incident_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    created TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL
);
"""


def _now(clock: Callable[[], float] | None) -> float:
    return clock() if clock is not None else time.time()


class SQLiteIncidentStore:
    def __init__(
        self,
        database: str,
        clock: Callable[[], float] | None = None,
        dedupe_window: float = DEFAULT_DEDUPE_WINDOW,
        lease_seconds: float = DEFAULT_LEASE_SECONDS,
    ) -> None:
        self.database = database
        self._clock = clock
        self.dedupe_window = dedupe_window
        self.lease_seconds = lease_seconds
        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(database, isolation_level=None, timeout=30.0)
        self._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self._conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        self._conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")
        self._conn.executescript(_SCHEMA)

    # -- helpers -----------------------------------------------------------

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._conn.close()

    def __enter__(self) -> "SQLiteIncidentStore":
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc: object) -> None:
        self.close()

    def _row_to_incident(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> Incident:
        return Incident(
            id=row["id"],
            fingerprint=row["fingerprint"],
            title=row["title"],
            severity=Severity(row["severity"]),
            status=IncidentStatus(row["status"]),
            owner=row["owner"],
            alert_count=row["alert_count"],
            version=row["version"],
            escalation_level=row["escalation_level"],
            created_at=row["created_at"],
            updated_at=row["updated_at"],
            sla_deadline=row["sla_deadline"],
        )

    def _row_to_event(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> AuditEvent:
        return AuditEvent(
            id=row["id"],
            incident_id=row["incident_id"],
            type=row["type"],
            timestamp=row["timestamp"],
            details=json.loads(row["details"]),
        )

    def _add_event(
        self,
        cur: sqlite3.Cursor,
        incident_id: str,
        event_type: str,
        timestamp: float,
        details: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> None:
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO audit_events (incident_id, type, timestamp, details) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (incident_id, event_type, timestamp, json.dumps(details)),
        )

    # -- ingest ------------------------------------------------------------

    def ingest_alert(
        self,
        fingerprint: str,
        title: str,
        severity: Severity | str,
        source: str = "unknown",
        details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        idempotency_key: str | None = None,
        now: float | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Incident, bool]:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        sev = Severity(severity)
        detail_payload = details or {}
        fp = fingerprint
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                row = cur.execute(
                    "SELECT incident_id, created, result_json FROM idempotency "
                    "WHERE key = ?",
                    (idempotency_key,),
                ).fetchone()
                if row is not None:
                    created_flag = row["created"]
                    self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                    return (
                        self.get(row["incident_id"]),  # type: ignore[return-value]
                        created_flag == "created",
                    )
            existing = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE fingerprint = ? AND status != 'resolved' "
                "ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1",
                (fp,),
            ).fetchone()
            if existing is not None:
                incident = self._row_to_incident(existing)
                if ts - incident.updated_at <= self.dedupe_window:
                    new_version = incident.version + 1
                    cur.execute(
                        "UPDATE incidents SET alert_count = alert_count + 1, "
                        "version = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                        (new_version, ts, incident.id),
                    )
                    self._add_event(
                        cur,
                        incident.id,
                        "duplicate_alert",
                        ts,
                        {"source": source, "details": detail_payload},
                    )
                    result = self._row_to_incident(
                        cur.execute(
                            "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident.id,)
                        ).fetchone()
                    )
                    if idempotency_key is not None:
                        cur.execute(
                            "INSERT INTO idempotency (key, incident_id, created, result_json) "
                            "VALUES (?, ?, 'duplicate_alert', ?)",
                            (idempotency_key, result.id, json.dumps(None)),
                        )
                    self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                    return result, False
            incident_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            sla = ts + SLA_SECONDS[sev]
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO incidents "
                "(id, fingerprint, title, severity, status, owner, alert_count, "
                "version, escalation_level, created_at, updated_at, sla_deadline, "
                "claim_worker, claim_expires_at) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'open', NULL, 1, 1, 0, ?, ?, ?, NULL, NULL)",
                (
                    incident_id,
                    fp,
                    title,
                    sev.value,
                    ts,
                    ts,
                    sla,
                ),
            )
            self._add_event(
                cur,
                incident_id,
                "created",
                ts,
                {
                    "fingerprint": fp,
                    "title": title,
                    "severity": sev.value,
                    "source": source,
                    "details": detail_payload,
                },
            )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                cur.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO idempotency (key, incident_id, created, result_json) "
                    "VALUES (?, ?, 'created', ?)",
                    (idempotency_key, incident_id, json.dumps(None)),
                )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result, True
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    # -- reads -------------------------------------------------------------

    def get(self, incident_id: str) -> Incident | None:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        return self._row_to_incident(row) if row else None

    def list(
        self,
        status: str | None = None,
        severity: str | None = None,
        owner: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[Incident]:
        clauses: list[str] = []
        params: list[Any] = []
        if status is not None:
            clauses.append("status = ?")
            params.append(IncidentStatus(status).value)
        if severity is not None:
            clauses.append("severity = ?")
            params.append(Severity(severity).value)
        if owner is not None:
            clauses.append("owner = ?")
            params.append(owner)
        where = f"WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            f"SELECT * FROM incidents {where} ORDER BY created_at", params
        ).fetchall()
        return [self._row_to_incident(r) for r in rows]

    def events(self, incident_id: str) -> list[AuditEvent]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE incident_id = ? ORDER BY id",
            (incident_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [self._row_to_event(r) for r in rows]

    # -- updates -----------------------------------------------------------

    def update(
        self,
        incident_id: str,
        expected_version: int,
        owner: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        idempotency_key: str | None = None,
        now: float | None = None,
    ) -> Incident:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                row = cur.execute(
                    "SELECT incident_id, created FROM idempotency WHERE key = ?",
                    (idempotency_key,),
                ).fetchone()
                if row is not None:
                    self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                    return self.get(row["incident_id"])  # type: ignore[return-value]
            row = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise IncidentNotFound(incident_id)
            incident = self._row_to_incident(row)
            if incident.version != expected_version:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise VersionConflict(incident_id, expected_version, incident.version)
            new_owner = incident.owner
            new_status = incident.status
            owner_changed = False
            status_changed = False
            if owner is not None:
                stripped = owner.strip() or None
                if stripped != new_owner:
                    new_owner = stripped
                    owner_changed = True
            if status is not None:
                target = IncidentStatus(status)
                if target != new_status:
                    if (new_status, target) not in VALID_TRANSITIONS:
                        self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                        raise InvalidTransition(new_status.value, target.value)
                    new_status = target
                    status_changed = True
            if not owner_changed and not status_changed:
                self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                return incident
            new_version = incident.version + 1
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE incidents SET owner = ?, status = ?, version = ?, "
                "updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (
                    new_owner,
                    new_status.value,
                    new_version,
                    ts,
                    incident_id,
                ),
            )
            if owner_changed:
                self._add_event(
                    cur,
                    incident_id,
                    "owner_changed",
                    ts,
                    {"owner": new_owner},
                )
            if status_changed:
                self._add_event(
                    cur,
                    incident_id,
                    "status_changed",
                    ts,
                    {"from": incident.status.value, "to": new_status.value},
                )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                cur.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO idempotency (key, incident_id, created, result_json) "
                    "VALUES (?, ?, 'update', ?)",
                    (idempotency_key, incident_id, json.dumps(None)),
                )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result
        except Exception:
            try:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                pass
            raise

    # -- escalation --------------------------------------------------------

    def claim_due_escalation(
        self, worker_id: str, now: float | None = None
    ) -> Incident | None:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            row = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents "
                "WHERE status != 'resolved' AND claim_worker IS NULL "
                "AND sla_deadline <= ? "
                "ORDER BY sla_deadline ASC LIMIT 1",
                (ts,),
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                return None
            incident = self._row_to_incident(row)
            expires = ts + self.lease_seconds
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE incidents SET claim_worker = ?, claim_expires_at = ? "
                "WHERE id = ?",
                (worker_id, expires, incident.id),
            )
            self._add_event(
                cur,
                incident.id,
                "escalation_claimed",
                ts,
                {"worker_id": worker_id, "expires_at": expires},
            )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident.id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    def complete_escalation(
        self, incident_id: str, worker_id: str, now: float | None = None
    ) -> Incident:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            row = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise IncidentNotFound(incident_id)
            incident = self._row_to_incident(row)
            if row["claim_worker"] != worker_id:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise VersionConflict(incident_id, 0, incident.version)
            new_level = incident.escalation_level + 1
            new_version = incident.version + 1
            new_deadline = ts + SLA_SECONDS[incident.severity]
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE incidents SET escalation_level = ?, version = ?, "
                "sla_deadline = ?, claim_worker = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, "
                "updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (new_level, new_version, new_deadline, ts, incident_id),
            )
            self._add_event(
                cur,
                incident_id,
                "escalated",
                ts,
                {
                    "worker_id": worker_id,
                    "level": new_level,
                    "next_deadline": new_deadline,
                },
            )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result
        except (IncidentNotFound, VersionConflict):
            raise
        except Exception:
            try:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                pass
            raise

    def recover_expired_claims(self, now: float | None = None) -> int:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            rows = cur.execute(
                "SELECT id, claim_worker FROM incidents "
                "WHERE claim_worker IS NOT NULL AND claim_expires_at <= ?",
                (ts,),
            ).fetchall()
            count = 0
            for row in rows:
                cur.execute(
                    "UPDATE incidents SET claim_worker = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL "
                    "WHERE id = ?",
                    (row["id"],),
                )
                self._add_event(
                    cur,
                    row["id"],
                    "claim_recovered",
                    ts,
                    {"worker_id": row["claim_worker"]},
                )
                count += 1
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return count
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    # -- export / import ---------------------------------------------------

    def export_records(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        incidents = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM incidents ORDER BY created_at"
        ).fetchall()
        events = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM audit_events ORDER BY id"
        ).fetchall()
        result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for row in incidents:
            inc = self._row_to_incident(row)
            result.append(
                {
                    "kind": "incident",
                    "id": inc.id,
                    "fingerprint": inc.fingerprint,
                    "title": inc.title,
                    "severity": inc.severity.value,
                    "status": inc.status.value,
                    "owner": inc.owner,
                    "alert_count": inc.alert_count,
                    "version": inc.version,
                    "escalation_level": inc.escalation_level,
                    "created_at": inc.created_at,

                    "sla_deadline": inc.sla_deadline,
                    "claim_worker": row["claim_worker"],

"""Durable SQLite-backed incident store."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
import time
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from .models import (
    SLA_SECONDS,
    VALID_TRANSITIONS,
    AuditEvent,
    Incident,
    IncidentNotFound,
    IncidentStatus,
    InvalidTransition,
    Severity,
    VersionConflict,
)

DEFAULT_DEDUPE_WINDOW = 300.0
DEFAULT_LEASE_SECONDS = 30.0

_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incidents (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    owner TEXT,
    alert_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    escalation_level INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
    sla_deadline REAL NOT NULL,
    claim_worker TEXT,
    claim_expires_at REAL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_incidents_fingerprint
    ON incidents(fingerprint);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_incidents_status
    ON incidents(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_incidents_sla
    ON incidents(sla_deadline);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    incident_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    details TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (incident_id) REFERENCES incidents(id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_incident
    ON audit_events(incident_id, id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    incident_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    created TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL
);
"""


def _now(clock: Callable[[], float] | None) -> float:
    return clock() if clock is not None else time.time()


class SQLiteIncidentStore:
    def __init__(
        self,
        database: str,
        clock: Callable[[], float] | None = None,
        dedupe_window: float = DEFAULT_DEDUPE_WINDOW,
        lease_seconds: float = DEFAULT_LEASE_SECONDS,
    ) -> None:
        self.database = database
        self._clock = clock
        self.dedupe_window = dedupe_window
        self.lease_seconds = lease_seconds
        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(database, isolation_level=None, timeout=30.0)
        self._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self._conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        self._conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")
        self._conn.executescript(_SCHEMA)

    # -- helpers -----------------------------------------------------------

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._conn.close()

    def __enter__(self) -> "SQLiteIncidentStore":
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc: object) -> None:
        self.close()

    def _row_to_incident(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> Incident:
        return Incident(
            id=row["id"],
            fingerprint=row["fingerprint"],
            title=row["title"],
            severity=Severity(row["severity"]),
            status=IncidentStatus(row["status"]),
            owner=row["owner"],
            alert_count=row["alert_count"],
            version=row["version"],
            escalation_level=row["escalation_level"],
            created_at=row["created_at"],
            updated_at=row["updated_at"],
            sla_deadline=row["sla_deadline"],
        )

    def _row_to_event(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> AuditEvent:
        return AuditEvent(
            id=row["id"],
            incident_id=row["incident_id"],
            type=row["type"],
            timestamp=row["timestamp"],
            details=json.loads(row["details"]),
        )

    def _add_event(
        self,
        cur: sqlite3.Cursor,
        incident_id: str,
        event_type: str,
        timestamp: float,
        details: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> None:
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO audit_events (incident_id, type, timestamp, details) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (incident_id, event_type, timestamp, json.dumps(details)),
        )

    # -- ingest ------------------------------------------------------------

    def ingest_alert(
        self,
        fingerprint: str,
        title: str,
        severity: Severity | str,
        source: str = "unknown",
        details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        idempotency_key: str | None = None,
        now: float | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Incident, bool]:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        sev = Severity(severity)
        detail_payload = details or {}
        fp = fingerprint
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                row = cur.execute(
                    "SELECT incident_id, created, result_json FROM idempotency "
                    "WHERE key = ?",
                    (idempotency_key,),
                ).fetchone()
                if row is not None:
                    created_flag = row["created"]
                    self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                    return (
                        self.get(row["incident_id"]),  # type: ignore[return-value]
                        created_flag == "created",
                    )
            existing = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE fingerprint = ? AND status != 'resolved' "
                "ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1",
                (fp,),
            ).fetchone()
            if existing is not None:
                incident = self._row_to_incident(existing)
                if ts - incident.updated_at <= self.dedupe_window:
                    new_version = incident.version + 1
                    cur.execute(
                        "UPDATE incidents SET alert_count = alert_count + 1, "
                        "version = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                        (new_version, ts, incident.id),
                    )
                    self._add_event(
                        cur,
                        incident.id,
                        "duplicate_alert",
                        ts,
                        {"source": source, "details": detail_payload},
                    )
                    result = self._row_to_incident(
                        cur.execute(
                            "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident.id,)
                        ).fetchone()
                    )
                    if idempotency_key is not None:
                        cur.execute(
                            "INSERT INTO idempotency (key, incident_id, created, result_json) "
                            "VALUES (?, ?, 'duplicate_alert', ?)",
                            (idempotency_key, result.id, json.dumps(None)),
                        )
                    self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                    return result, False
            incident_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            sla = ts + SLA_SECONDS[sev]
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO incidents "
                "(id, fingerprint, title, severity, status, owner, alert_count, "
                "version, escalation_level, created_at, updated_at, sla_deadline, "
                "claim_worker, claim_expires_at) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'open', NULL, 1, 1, 0, ?, ?, ?, NULL, NULL)",
                (
                    incident_id,
                    fp,
                    title,
                    sev.value,
                    ts,
                    ts,
                    sla,
                ),
            )
            self._add_event(
                cur,
                incident_id,
                "created",
                ts,
                {
                    "fingerprint": fp,
                    "title": title,
                    "severity": sev.value,
                    "source": source,
                    "details": detail_payload,
                },
            )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                cur.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO idempotency (key, incident_id, created, result_json) "
                    "VALUES (?, ?, 'created', ?)",
                    (idempotency_key, incident_id, json.dumps(None)),
                )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result, True
        except Exception:
            try:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                pass
            raise

    # -- reads -------------------------------------------------------------

    def get(self, incident_id: str) -> Incident | None:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        return self._row_to_incident(row) if row else None

    def list(
        self,
        status: str | None = None,
        severity: str | None = None,
        owner: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[Incident]:
        clauses: list[str] = []
        params: list[Any] = []
        if status is not None:
            clauses.append("status = ?")
            params.append(IncidentStatus(status).value)
        if severity is not None:
            clauses.append("severity = ?")
            params.append(Severity(severity).value)
        if owner is not None:
            clauses.append("owner = ?")
            params.append(owner)
        where = f"WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            f"SELECT * FROM incidents {where} ORDER BY created_at", params
        ).fetchall()
        return [self._row_to_incident(r) for r in rows]

    def events(self, incident_id: str) -> list[AuditEvent]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE incident_id = ? ORDER BY id",
            (incident_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [self._row_to_event(r) for r in rows]

    # -- updates -----------------------------------------------------------

    def update(
        self,
        incident_id: str,
        expected_version: int,
        owner: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        idempotency_key: str | None = None,
        now: float | None = None,
    ) -> Incident:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                row = cur.execute(
                    "SELECT incident_id, created FROM idempotency WHERE key = ?",
                    (idempotency_key,),
                ).fetchone()
                if row is not None:
                    self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                    return self.get(row["incident_id"])  # type: ignore[return-value]
            row = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise IncidentNotFound(incident_id)
            incident = self._row_to_incident(row)
            if incident.version != expected_version:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise VersionConflict(incident_id, expected_version, incident.version)
            new_owner = incident.owner
            new_status = incident.status
            owner_changed = False
            status_changed = False
            if owner is not None:
                stripped = owner.strip() or None
                if stripped != new_owner:
                    new_owner = stripped
                    owner_changed = True
            if status is not None:
                target = IncidentStatus(status)
                if target != new_status:
                    if (new_status, target) not in VALID_TRANSITIONS:
                        self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                        raise InvalidTransition(new_status.value, target.value)
                    new_status = target
                    status_changed = True
            if not owner_changed and not status_changed:
                self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                return incident
            new_version = incident.version + 1
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE incidents SET owner = ?, status = ?, version = ?, "
                "updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (
                    new_owner,
                    new_status.value,
                    new_version,
                    ts,
                    incident_id,
                ),
            )
            if owner_changed:
                self._add_event(
                    cur,
                    incident_id,
                    "owner_changed",
                    ts,
                    {"owner": new_owner},
                )
            if status_changed:
                self._add_event(
                    cur,
                    incident_id,
                    "status_changed",
                    ts,
                    {"from": incident.status.value, "to": new_status.value},
                )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                cur.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO idempotency (key, incident_id, created, result_json) "
                    "VALUES (?, ?, 'update', ?)",
                    (idempotency_key, incident_id, json.dumps(None)),
                )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result
        except Exception:
            try:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                pass
            raise

    # -- escalation --------------------------------------------------------

    def claim_due_escalation(
        self, worker_id: str, now: float | None = None
    ) -> Incident | None:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            row = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents "
                "WHERE status != 'resolved' AND claim_worker IS NULL "
                "AND sla_deadline <= ? "
                "ORDER BY sla_deadline ASC LIMIT 1",
                (ts,),
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                return None
            incident = self._row_to_incident(row)
            expires = ts + self.lease_seconds
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE incidents SET claim_worker = ?, claim_expires_at = ? "
                "WHERE id = ?",
                (worker_id, expires, incident.id),
            )
            self._add_event(
                cur,
                incident.id,
                "escalation_claimed",
                ts,
                {"worker_id": worker_id, "expires_at": expires},
            )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident.id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    def complete_escalation(
        self, incident_id: str, worker_id: str, now: float | None = None
    ) -> Incident:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            row = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise IncidentNotFound(incident_id)
            incident = self._row_to_incident(row)
            if row["claim_worker"] != worker_id:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise VersionConflict(incident_id, 0, incident.version)
            new_level = incident.escalation_level + 1
            new_version = incident.version + 1
            new_deadline = ts + SLA_SECONDS[incident.severity]
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE incidents SET escalation_level = ?, version = ?, "
                "sla_deadline = ?, claim_worker = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, "
                "updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (new_level, new_version, new_deadline, ts, incident_id),
            )
            self._add_event(
                cur,
                incident_id,
                "escalated",
                ts,
                {
                    "worker_id": worker_id,
                    "level": new_level,
                    "next_deadline": new_deadline,
                },
            )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result
        except (IncidentNotFound, VersionConflict):
            raise
        except Exception:
            try:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                pass
            raise

    def recover_expired_claims(self, now: float | None = None) -> int:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            rows = cur.execute(
                "SELECT id, claim_worker FROM incidents "
                "WHERE claim_worker IS NOT NULL AND claim_expires_at <= ?",
                (ts,),
            ).fetchall()
            count = 0
            for row in rows:
                cur.execute(
                    "UPDATE incidents SET claim_worker = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL "
                    "WHERE id = ?",
                    (row["id"],),
                )
                self._add_event(
                    cur,
                    row["id"],
                    "claim_recovered",
                    ts,
                    {"worker_id": row["claim_worker"]},
                )
                count += 1
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return count
        except Exception:
            try:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                pass
            raise

    # -- export / import ---------------------------------------------------

    def export_records(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        incidents = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM incidents ORDER BY created_at"
        ).fetchall()
        events = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM audit_events ORDER BY id"
        ).fetchall()
        result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for row in incidents:
            inc = self._row_to_incident(row)
            result.append(
                {
                    "kind": "incident",
                    "id": inc.id,
                    "fingerprint": inc.fingerprint,
                    "title": inc.title,
                    "severity": inc.severity.value,
                    "status": inc.status.value,
                    "owner": inc.owner,
                    "alert_count": inc.alert_count,
                    "version": inc.version,
                    "escalation_level": inc.escalation_level,
                    "created_at": inc.created_at,
                    "updated_at": inc.updated_at,
                    "sla_deadline": inc.sla_deadline,
                    "claim_worker": row["claim_worker"],
                    "claim_expires_at": row["claim_expires_at"],
                }
            )
        for row in events:
            ev = self._row_to_event(row)
            result.append(
                {
                    "kind": "event",
                    "id": ev.id,
                    "incident_id": ev.incident_id,
                    "type": ev.type,
                    "timestamp": ev.timestamp,
                    "details": ev.details,
                }
            )
        return result

    def import_records(self, records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            imported = 0
            for record in records:
                if record["kind"] == "incident":
                    existing = cur.execute(
                        "SELECT 1 FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (record["id"],)
                    ).fetchone()
                    if existing:
                        continue
                    cur.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO incidents "
                        "(id, fingerprint, title, severity, status, owner, "
                        "alert_count, version, escalation_level, created_at, "
                        "updated_at, sla_deadline, claim_worker, claim_expires_at) "
                        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        (
                            record["id"],
                            record["fingerprint"],
                            record["title"],
                            record["severity"],
                            record["status"],
                            record["owner"],
                            record["alert_count"],
                            record["version"],
                            record["escalation_level"],
                            record["created_at"],
                            record["updated_at"],
                            record["sla_deadline"],
                            record.get("claim_worker"),
                            record.get("claim_expires_at"),
                        ),
                    )
                    imported += 1
                elif record["kind"] == "event":
                    existing = cur.execute(
                        "SELECT 1 FROM audit_events WHERE id = ?", (record["id"],)
                    ).fetchone()
                    if existing:
                        continue
                    cur.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO audit_events "
                        "(id, incident_id, type, timestamp, details) "
                        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        (
                            record["id"],
                            record["incident_id"],
                            record["type"],
                            record["timestamp"],
                            json.dumps(record["details"]),
                        ),
                    )
                    imported += 1
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return imported
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    def __exit__(self, *exc: object) -> None:
        self.close()

    def _row_to_incident(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> Incident:
        return Incident(
            id=row["id"],
            fingerprint=row["fingerprint"],
            title=row["title"],
            severity=Severity(row["severity"]),
            status=IncidentStatus(row["status"]),
            owner=row["owner"],
            alert_count=row["alert_count"],
            version=row["version"],
            escalation_level=row["escalation_level"],
            created_at=row["created_at"],
            updated_at=row["updated_at"],
            sla_deadline=row["sla_deadline"],
        )

    def _row_to_event(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> AuditEvent:
        return AuditEvent(
            id=row["id"],
            incident_id=row["incident_id"],
            type=row["type"],
            timestamp=row["timestamp"],
            details=json.loads(row["details"]),
        )

    def _add_event(
        self,
        cur: sqlite3.Cursor,
        incident_id: str,
        event_type: str,
        timestamp: float,
        details: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> None:
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO audit_events (incident_id, type, timestamp, details) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (incident_id, event_type, timestamp, json.dumps(details)),
        )

    # -- ingest ------------------------------------------------------------

    def ingest_alert(
        self,
        fingerprint: str,
        title: str,
        severity: Severity | str,
        source: str = "unknown",
        details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        idempotency_key: str | None = None,
        now: float | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Incident, bool]:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        sev = Severity(severity)
        detail_payload = details or {}
        fp = fingerprint
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                row = cur.execute(
                    "SELECT incident_id, created, result_json FROM idempotency "
                    "WHERE key = ?",
                    (idempotency_key,),
                ).fetchone()
                if row is not None:
                    created_flag = row["created"]
                    self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                    return (
                        self.get(row["incident_id"]),  # type: ignore[return-value]
                        created_flag == "created",
                    )
            existing = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE fingerprint = ? AND status != 'resolved' "
                "ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1",
                (fp,),
            ).fetchone()
            if existing is not None:
                incident = self._row_to_incident(existing)
                if ts - incident.updated_at <= self.dedupe_window:
                    new_version = incident.version + 1
                    cur.execute(
                        "UPDATE incidents SET alert_count = alert_count + 1, "
                        "version = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                        (new_version, ts, incident.id),
                    )
                    self._add_event(
                        cur,
                        incident.id,
                        "duplicate_alert",
                        ts,
                        {"source": source, "details": detail_payload},
                    )
                    result = self._row_to_incident(
                        cur.execute(
                            "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident.id,)
                        ).fetchone()
                    )
                    if idempotency_key is not None:
                        cur.execute(
                            "INSERT INTO idempotency (key, incident_id, created, result_json) "
                            "VALUES (?, ?, 'duplicate_alert', ?)",
                            (idempotency_key, result.id, json.dumps(None)),
                        )
                    self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                    return result, False
            incident_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            sla = ts + SLA_SECONDS[sev]
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO incidents "
                "(id, fingerprint, title, severity, status, owner, alert_count, "
                "version, escalation_level, created_at, updated_at, sla_deadline, "
                "claim_worker, claim_expires_at) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'open', NULL, 1, 1, 0, ?, ?, ?, NULL, NULL)",
                (
                    incident_id,
                    fp,
                    title,
                    sev.value,
                    ts,
                    ts,
                    sla,
                ),
            )
            self._add_event(
                cur,
                incident_id,
                "created",
                ts,
                {
                    "fingerprint": fp,
                    "title": title,
                    "severity": sev.value,
                    "source": source,
                    "details": detail_payload,
                },
            )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                cur.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO idempotency (key, incident_id, created, result_json) "
                    "VALUES (?, ?, 'created', ?)",
                    (idempotency_key, incident_id, json.dumps(None)),
                )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result, True
        except Exception:
            try:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                pass
            raise

    # -- reads -------------------------------------------------------------

    def get(self, incident_id: str) -> Incident | None:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        return self._row_to_incident(row) if row else None

    def list(
        self,
        status: str | None = None,
        severity: str | None = None,
        owner: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[Incident]:
        clauses: list[str] = []
        params: list[Any] = []
        if status is not None:
            clauses.append("status = ?")
            params.append(IncidentStatus(status).value)
        if severity is not None:
            clauses.append("severity = ?")
            params.append(Severity(severity).value)
        if owner is not None:
            clauses.append("owner = ?")
            params.append(owner)
        where = f"WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            f"SELECT * FROM incidents {where} ORDER BY created_at", params
        ).fetchall()
        return [self._row_to_incident(r) for r in rows]

    def events(self, incident_id: str) -> list[AuditEvent]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE incident_id = ? ORDER BY id",
            (incident_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [self._row_to_event(r) for r in rows]

    # -- updates -----------------------------------------------------------

    def update(
        self,
        incident_id: str,
        expected_version: int,
        owner: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        idempotency_key: str | None = None,
        now: float | None = None,
    ) -> Incident:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                row = cur.execute(
                    "SELECT incident_id, created FROM idempotency WHERE key = ?",
                    (idempotency_key,),
                ).fetchone()
                if row is not None:
                    self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                    return self.get(row["incident_id"])  # type: ignore[return-value]
            row = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise IncidentNotFound(incident_id)
            incident = self._row_to_incident(row)
            if incident.version != expected_version:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise VersionConflict(incident_id, expected_version, incident.version)
            new_owner = incident.owner
            new_status = incident.status
            owner_changed = False
            status_changed = False
            if owner is not None:
                stripped = owner.strip() or None
                if stripped != new_owner:
                    new_owner = stripped
                    owner_changed = True
            if status is not None:
                target = IncidentStatus(status)
                if target != new_status:
                    if (new_status, target) not in VALID_TRANSITIONS:
                        self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                        raise InvalidTransition(new_status.value, target.value)
                    new_status = target
                    status_changed = True
            if not owner_changed and not status_changed:
                self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                return incident
            new_version = incident.version + 1
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE incidents SET owner = ?, status = ?, version = ?, "
                "updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (
                    new_owner,
                    new_status.value,
                    new_version,
                    ts,
                    incident_id,
                ),
            )
            if owner_changed:
                self._add_event(
                    cur,
                    incident_id,
                    "owner_changed",
                    ts,
                    {"owner": new_owner},
                )
            if status_changed:
                self._add_event(
                    cur,
                    incident_id,
                    "status_changed",
                    ts,
                    {"from": incident.status.value, "to": new_status.value},
                )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            if idempotency_key is not None:
                cur.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO idempotency (key, incident_id, created, result_json) "
                    "VALUES (?, ?, 'update', ?)",
                    (idempotency_key, incident_id, json.dumps(None)),
                )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result
        except Exception:
            try:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                pass
            raise

    # -- escalation --------------------------------------------------------

    def claim_due_escalation(
        self, worker_id: str, now: float | None = None
    ) -> Incident | None:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            row = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents "
                "WHERE status != 'resolved' AND claim_worker IS NULL "
                "AND sla_deadline <= ? "
                "ORDER BY sla_deadline ASC LIMIT 1",
                (ts,),
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
                return None
            incident = self._row_to_incident(row)
            expires = ts + self.lease_seconds
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE incidents SET claim_worker = ?, claim_expires_at = ? "
                "WHERE id = ?",
                (worker_id, expires, incident.id),
            )
            self._add_event(
                cur,
                incident.id,
                "escalation_claimed",
                ts,
                {"worker_id": worker_id, "expires_at": expires},
            )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident.id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    def complete_escalation(
        self, incident_id: str, worker_id: str, now: float | None = None
    ) -> Incident:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            row = cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise IncidentNotFound(incident_id)
            incident = self._row_to_incident(row)
            if row["claim_worker"] != worker_id:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise VersionConflict(incident_id, 0, incident.version)
            new_level = incident.escalation_level + 1
            new_version = incident.version + 1
            new_deadline = ts + SLA_SECONDS[incident.severity]
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE incidents SET escalation_level = ?, version = ?, "
                "sla_deadline = ?, claim_worker = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, "
                "updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (new_level, new_version, new_deadline, ts, incident_id),
            )
            self._add_event(
                cur,
                incident_id,
                "escalated",
                ts,
                {
                    "worker_id": worker_id,
                    "level": new_level,
                    "next_deadline": new_deadline,
                },
            )
            result = self._row_to_incident(
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return result
        except (IncidentNotFound, VersionConflict):
            raise
        except Exception:
            try:
                self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                pass
            raise

    def recover_expired_claims(self, now: float | None = None) -> int:
        ts = now if now is not None else _now(self._clock)
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            rows = cur.execute(
                "SELECT id, claim_worker FROM incidents "
                "WHERE claim_worker IS NOT NULL AND claim_expires_at <= ?",
                (ts,),
            ).fetchall()
            count = 0
            for row in rows:
                cur.execute(
                    "UPDATE incidents SET claim_worker = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL "
                    "WHERE id = ?",
                    (row["id"],),
                )
                self._add_event(
                    cur,
                    row["id"],
                    "claim_recovered",
                    ts,
                    {"worker_id": row["claim_worker"]},
                )
                count += 1
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return count
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    # -- export / import ---------------------------------------------------

    def export_records(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        incidents = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM incidents ORDER BY created_at"
        ).fetchall()
        events = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM audit_events ORDER BY id"
        ).fetchall()
        result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for row in incidents:
            inc = self._row_to_incident(row)
            result.append(
                {
                    "kind": "incident",
                    "id": inc.id,
                    "fingerprint": inc.fingerprint,
                    "title": inc.title,
                    "severity": inc.severity.value,
                    "status": inc.status.value,
                    "owner": inc.owner,
                    "alert_count": inc.alert_count,
                    "version": inc.version,
                    "escalation_level": inc.escalation_level,
                    "created_at": inc.created_at,
                    "updated_at": inc.updated_at,
                    "sla_deadline": inc.sla_deadline,
                    "claim_worker": row["claim_worker"],
                    "claim_expires_at": row["claim_expires_at"],
                }
            )
        for row in events:
            ev = self._row_to_event(row)
            result.append(
                {
                    "kind": "event",
                    "id": ev.id,
                    "incident_id": ev.incident_id,
                    "type": ev.type,
                    "timestamp": ev.timestamp,
                    "details": ev.details,
                }
            )
        return result

    def import_records(self, records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
        cur = self._conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            imported = 0
            for record in records:
                if record["kind"] == "incident":
                    existing = cur.execute(
                        "SELECT 1 FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (record["id"],)
                    ).fetchone()
                    if existing:
                        continue
                    cur.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO incidents "
                        "(id, fingerprint, title, severity, status, owner, "
                        "alert_count, version, escalation_level, created_at, "
                        "updated_at, sla_deadline, claim_worker, claim_expires_at) "
                        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        (
                            record["id"],
                            record["fingerprint"],
                            record["title"],
                            record["severity"],
                            record["status"],
                            record["owner"],
                            record["alert_count"],
                            record["version"],
                            record["escalation_level"],
                            record["created_at"],
                            record["updated_at"],
                            record["sla_deadline"],
                            record.get("claim_worker"),
                            record.get("claim_expires_at"),
                        ),
                    )
                    imported += 1
                elif record["kind"] == "event":
                    existing = cur.execute(
                        "SELECT 1 FROM audit_events WHERE id = ?", (record["id"],)
                    ).fetchone()
                    if existing:
                        continue
                    cur.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO audit_events "
                        "(id, incident_id, type, timestamp, details) "
                        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        (
                            record["id"],
                            record["incident_id"],
                            record["type"],
                            record["timestamp"],
                            json.dumps(record["details"]),
                        ),
                    )
                    imported += 1
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            return imported
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise
